csv_project_name: Architectural Services for Barre Residential Elevations
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Barre, Vermont is requesting proposals from qualified architectural firms to provide professional architectural services for the Barre Residential Elevation Program. The project consists of the elevation of three residential properties located within the Special Flood Hazard Area (SFHA) in Barre, Vermont. The selected architect will support the City and Project Manager in the development of elevation plans, coordination with engineering consultants, permitting, and construction-phase support. The three residential properties included in this project are: 17 Vine Street, Barre, Vermont 114 River Street, Barre, Vermont 22 Berlin Street, Barre, Vermont
